name: PSF-based Multiple Scattering Rendering
aliases: Elek et al. (2013) Screen-Space Multiple Scattering
PSF-based Multiple Scattering Rendering — Elek et al. (2013)
definition: A practical method for rendering volumetric multiple scattering effects by treating the medium as a point spread function (PSF) that blurs incident radiance, avoiding costly direct numerical simulation of the radiative transfer equation.
summary: PSF-based Multiple Scattering Rendering approximates volumetric light transport by convolving a vacuum-rendered image with a spatially varying Gaussian Point Spread Function, enabling real-time performance for homogeneous media.
